derived_reservation.docker_engineering_reserve: Separately propose 768 MiB on proven Docker backing FS: 256 MiB state DB + 256 MiB journal engineering reserve + 256 MiB margin. Existing statvfs sees container scope only.
derived_reservation.host_engineering_reserve: 15*256 MiB roots + 5*(256 MiB main DB + proposed 256 MiB rollback journal reserve) + 256 MiB free-space margin = 6.5 GiB, conditional on all paths sharing the measured filesystem. Per-DB journal reserve is not a SQLite guarantee.
derived_reservation.multiple_fs: Resolve each fixed path to filesystem identity and aggregate required bytes by that device; workspace root free bytes alone cannot justify the sum.
derived_reservation.not_a_reservation: Preflight does not reserve physical blocks. External consumption can still produce ENOSPC/SQLITE_FULL; safe incomplete/fail-closed handling is a separate property.

first_normal_run.authority: No further volume or DB path: embedded CI gate and standalone tools/gah_ci.py append/query the same authority.sqlite on state volume; standalone gah_ci only emits stdout locally.
first_normal_run.path: tools/setup_request.resolve -> .ga/runtime/<setup_id>/supervised/<sha256(run_id)>; setup apply writes run_prepare and request files only. It does not execute normal trials; setup result explicitly current_ci_checked=false.

minimal_closure: Keep bound_verified=false; add an explicit bounded retry count including clock failures.
Derive and enforce per-writer maxima from fixed plan entries/stages and serialized lengths; reserve temp and in-flight bytes before write.
Resolve every host root/SQLite DB to actual filesystem and enforce/project-quota or isolated bounded filesystem over roots, main DBs, journals, and lock sidecars.
Obtain Docker-backend-specific quota/free capacity for the actual state volume backing store; do not substitute in-container statvfs.
Use a bounded filesystem/quota fixture to inject SQLITE_FULL/ENOSPC and verify no success receipt, immutable old bytes retained, incomplete state retained, replay stable.
Keep logical cap, preflight observation, physical bound, and post-observation ENOSPC safety as separate claims.

profile_estimates.caveat: LLM stage counts are 600/600/1200/1200 while runner-call counts are 400/400/800/800. This is intentionally conservative as an estimate but not measured or enforced per writer.
profile_estimates.formula: tools/setup_capacity.py uses 32*1 MiB documents*SQLite factor 2 per stage, 1 GiB management, 4-stage reserve, plus 256 MiB doctor margin. Formula is not tied to writer reservations and bound_verified=false.

retry.finite_count_caveat: Authority clock-rejection files have UUID names; each client invocation may add up to two. Repeating the same request through arbitrarily many clock failures can create distinct sidecars; aggregate directory cap/entry limit fail closed, but no fixed per-request retry counter bounds that path.
retry.incomplete: Partial checkpoint/temp/DB state is retained and counts against caps; no cleanup/reset assumed.
retry.same_request: Stable operation journal/checkpoint keys, same run folder/DB, same operation lock names; successful immutable artifacts replay by identical bytes and do not create another root/database.

scope.operation: one setup apply for one new plan plus its first normal gah_run --setup-plan run; selected profile is sample-ci OR sample-llm
scope.retry: same request/run identities; successful immutable replay reuses same paths

bounded_roots.limits: 256 MiB/direct root; 65,536 entries; 1 MiB/document; temporary publication and root lock sidecar count against root. Nested roots are separate caps, not aggregated.

docker.inspect: Owner/name/local driver is checked; no quota is set. In-container /state statvfs does not prove host DockerRootDir or Docker Desktop/WSL VHDX backing free space.
paths: <prefix>-state -> /state/authority.sqlite via tools/authority_entry.py and gah.adoption.AdoptionStore; main DB 256 MiB cap

counts.note: operation_lock keys are stable on replay but sibling lock files are outside write_bounded root byte accounting.

setup_apply.ordering: setup apply opens journal and writes identity/outputs-initially-absent checkpoint before capacity_profile/bootstrap doctor. Preflight precedes images/volume/adoption/sample execution, not all setup writes.

sample-llm.note: plan entries/runner calls differ from worker stages; 400/400/800 is lock/DB-operation count, 600/600/1200 is stage count

sqlite.gap: Main DB pages capped; DELETE rollback journal has no separate byte cap. MEMORY temp_store controls spill to disk but not peak RAM.
sqlite.settings: src/gah/sqlite_limits.py reapplies/readbacks max_page_count per connection preserving page_size; DELETE journal, FULL synchronous, MEMORY temp. WAL and over-cap DB rejected without conversion.

unproved.gap: Rollback-journal byte peak lacks strict filesystem quota or supported-SQLite worst-case transaction envelope.
No per-root filesystem/device identity; nested mounts can invalidate one-workspace-free-space aggregation.
Docker named volume inspect and in-container statvfs do not prove Docker Desktop/WSL VHDX or daemon backing capacity.
Capacity observation races concurrent consumption; ENOSPC behavior must be tested independently.
Unbounded repeated clock-rejection retries can add UUID sidecars up to aggregate root caps.
Stable runner operation-lock siblings are finite for one graph but outside bounded directory accounting.
Image acquisition is excluded by setup profile but included in PAC09 elapsed-time scope; setup apply only inspects existing locked images.

verdict.reason: write_bounded caps each dedicated direct-directory logical root and SQLite max_page_count caps main DB pages. DELETE rollback-journal physical bytes have no separate quota/readback; host roots may be on separate mounts; Docker local volumes have no proven host backing quota; free space can be consumed after observation.
